title: [finding] `check-role-word` cannot exempt a machine-generated region inside a hand-written page — its generated-content exclusion is keyed to a directory name
body:
Found while building the tenant-audit census artifact (#13548). No severity asserted; this records what was driven and what came back.

## The shape

`check-role-word` ratchets the ADR-0090 D3 reserved word out of author-written prose. Its scope is `content/docs` and `skills`, and it already knows that GENERATED content is not author prose — it excludes one directory for exactly that reason:

```js
// Scope: content/docs (hand-written; references/ is generated from spec and
// excluded — the spec source is the fix site there) and skills/.
const SKIP_DIRS = new Set(['node_modules', '.git', 'dist', 'references']);
```

**The exclusion is keyed to a directory NAME.** That works while every generated page lives under `content/docs/references/`, and it cannot express a page that is hand-written prose *around* a machine-generated region — the `{/* BEGIN GENERATED: … */}` convention already used by `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx`.

## What was measured

A census page emitting a table of source paths tripped the gate on one row, because a real file in this tree is named `member-role-canonical.ts` and `\brole\b` matches inside it (the hyphen is a word boundary — the gate's own docblock notes this property):

```
check-role-word: 1 problem(s)
  • content/docs/permissions/tenant-audit-census.mdx: NEW use of the reserved word (1 occurrence(s)).
```

The occurrence was inside a generated region, in an inline code span holding an exact source path. None of the gate's three remedies fit:

- **reword** — it is an emitted file path; rewording it falsifies the artifact;
- **marked vendor-wire fence** — it is not a vendor wire, and `VENDOR_BOUNDARIES` correctly admits only `better-auth`;
- **baseline** — explicitly ⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY, and the gate says in as many words: do not take this path to get CI green.

⇒ **Any docs page that cites that source file by path is unshippable by an author acting correctly.** It is not specific to one filename: it is every generated path a census, ledger or reference emits.

## How it was worked around, and why that is not a fix

The row table was moved to `docs/audits/…counts.md`, outside both roots. That split is defensible on its own merits — it is the same split `packages/spec`'s strictness ledger already uses, and it keeps 140 rows of machine output off the docs site — but it was **prompted by this gate**, not chosen freely, and it does not help a page that needs generated paths inline.

## Suggested shape, not a prescription

Skip the span between `{/* BEGIN GENERATED: … */}` and its `END` marker, the same way `references/` is skipped and for the same stated reason: the fix site for generated content is its generator, never the page. The ratchet over author prose is untouched, and the exemption stays greppable — a marker pair in a diff rather than a property of a directory's name.

## Not addressed by this card

- the baseline's contents, its shrink-only rule, or the maintainer gate on expanding it — all correct as they stand;
- whether `member-role-canonical.ts` should be renamed. Renaming one file leaves the class open.
